CI/CD Pipeline:

(A) GitHub Actions → AWS STS: OIDC Auth

(B) AWS STS → CloudFormation: AWS SAM Deploy

System Data Flow:

(1) Client → Cognito → API Gateway: Auth & API Request

(2) API Gateway → Lambda: Route Request

(3) Lambda ↔ Aurora (MySQL): Read/Write Metadata

(4) Client → S3 Bucket: Direct Upload/Download

(5) S3 Bucket → Lambda: S3 Event Trigger

(7) Lambda → Aurora (MySQL): Save OCR Results

(8) API Gateway → Step Functions: Trigger Approval Workflow

(9) Step Functions → SNS: Send Notification
